summary: T1-04 round 3 passes. All three story checks pass. The round-2 blocker (codex-r2-1) is fixed and its tests pass. Every acceptance criterion holds on the evidence I saw. The committed record says stokes_observation is not_performed because the archive has no S4 layer, and it carries no verdict. The two earlier rebuttals (claude-r2-1 and the round-1 notes) are sound.

checks.evidence: 1235 passed, 2 xfailed. The xfails are the ProductRecord and Sources schema-case fixtures, which are outside T1-01's files.

checks.criterion: uv run python -m terraluna_pipeline.pilot check minirf
checks.command: uv run python -m terraluna_pipeline.pilot check minirf

checks.evidence: ruff check passed, ruff format --check reported 19 files already formatted, mypy found no issues in 19 source files.

checks.criterion: AC1-AC3, AC6: label parser and range-read helper in io.py, range requests only, pyproj window, upserted ProductRecords, changes limited to the story's files
checks.evidence: The diff stat lists only the story's files: io.py, pilot.py, the test files, outputs/sources.json, outputs/pilot/minirf_mosaic.json, pyproject.toml and uv.lock. test_io_pds3.py, test_io_tls.py and test_pilot_minirf.py pass. The 'check minirf' command re-verifies the committed outputs against data/raw/minirf/. I did not read the code paths line by line.

The record has label, data, range_read, window, cpr_statistics, transmit_handedness, look_direction, incidence, null_value, units, layout_leads, special_values, verification and open_g0_items. label_url, data_url and label_sha256 are not flat keys. The values sit under label.url, data.url and label.sha256, so the round-2 rebuttal stands.

status is not_performed, with a reason. The reason says the 24 labels describe CPR and S1 layers only and no S4 layer exists. It also says the verdict belongs to polarimetry.lunar_s4_sign_check (T2-05) and that CPR is never used to infer S4. Tests cover the Stokes-present path: pair reads, the bit-pattern oracle for raw statistics, and a refusal that keeps the windows already read. The fix for codex-r2-1 is verified by passing tests.

findings.claim: The real archive has no S4 layer, so the Stokes-present code path is exercised only by synthetic tests. This is expected, and the record correctly reports not_performed.
findings.evidence: stokes_observation.status is not_performed. The record lists the MAP-V1.0 single-swath read as an open G0 item.
